title: How To Fix Google Chrome Not Working/Opening Error On Windows 10

asr.full_text: Hey Guys , I am Shubhankar from Techransgadgets and today I am going to show you how to fix chrome.exe not working error I recently updated my PC to Windows 10 and noticed that Google Chrome was not working anymore I think some system files got corrupted in the installation So to fix that, first delete any shortcuts of chrome.exe on your computer like I have here as you can see Windows cannot see programs blah blah blah so delete that. Unpin now go to file manager, go to the click on we name, now type google Chrome and enter. now you need to restart your computer now after restarting your device go again back to the file manager go to Windows C drive... again into the chrome... and you can see now that it has been fixed ... I can show you that... by creating a shortcut ... yes !! and now click on Google Chrome ... as you can see Google Chrome is Click on google chrome As you can see google chrome is working also note that you might need to clean your registry before restarting your device it helps a bit in this process here we go. Google is working perfectly. Thanks for watching Tech Run's gadgets. If this helped you, please like our video and subscribe to our channel to see more videos like this and thanks again for watching. See you again on the next one!
